summary: Full E2E regression on Phase 9 push notifications + version banner + Treesh news + admin announcements. Ran backend harness (push_api_test.mjs: 64/64), UI desktop (push_ui.py d: 47/47), UI mobile (push_ui.py m: 47/47), notification center regression (nt.py: clean, no errors). Reviewed push.mjs / push-lib.mjs / deploy-succeeded.mjs for security and logic. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: push.mjs/push-lib.mjs: secret check uses timingSafeEqual (good), admin+ban gate on announce (good), endpoint allow-list via HOSTS regex with PUSH_EXTRA_HOSTS escape hatch for tests (good), 404/410 cleanup via sendTo gone list (good), prefs filter applied before fan-out, 15s rate limit on /test (good), 8KB body cap and B64 key length bounds on /subscribe (good). No ObjectId or env leaks observed.
deploy-succeeded.mjs correctly skips non-production contexts; first-version is only recorded (no spam) which matches intent.

push_ui.py already covers: Settings card, 4-type switches, test send, signed-out locking, prefs sync debounce, one-time ask on 2nd visit, iPhone standalone hint path, version banner (shown/dismissed/refresh URL cleanup/no-banner on match), news ingestion from SW message, SW openWindow -> ?nt=n<id>, Admin Announcements composer validation + confirm + send + recent list. All green on both desktop and mobile viewports.
